#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long ar[3], br[3];
    cin >> ar[0] >> ar[1] >> ar[2];
    cin >> br[0] >> br[1] >> br[2];

    long long maxWins = 0;
    long long minNonWins = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        long long winAdd = min(ar[i], br[(i+1)%3]);
        maxWins += winAdd;

        long long loseMaybe = min(br[i], ar[(i+1)%3]);
        long long drawMaybe = min(br[i], ar[i]);
        long long sum = loseMaybe + drawMaybe;
        long long cycleLose = min(br[i], sum);
        minNonWins += cycleLose;
    }

    cout << (n - minNonWins) << " " << maxWins << endl;
    return 0;
}
